name: High-Ticket B2B Lead Gen ICP
description: B2B SaaS and high-ticket businesses needing qualified demo bookings through paid ads

scoring_guide.10: Clear 'Book a demo' or 'Schedule a call' CTA
scoring_guide.7: Contact sales / Get a quote model

buyer_reachability.description: Decision-maker (founder, CEO, VP) reachable on Meta or LinkedIn

scoring_guide.10: Clearly targets business owners/executives, active on social

pain_point_clarity.description: Clear, emotionally-charged pain point for ad creative

traction.description: Has clients, revenue, proof points - not pre-revenue

scoring_guide.10: Clear traction signals (logos, testimonials, case studies)
scoring_guide.0: Looks pre-revenue or very early stage

scoring_guide.10: Perfect fit - B2B SaaS or high-ticket service
